name: Brightery Conversion Toolkit for WooCommerce
author: Brightery

sections.description:
Brightery Conversion Toolkit for WooCommerce helps you increase sales with a suite of conversion tools:
* Sales Pop: Show recent sales notifications to build trust.
* Sticky Add to Cart: Keep the buy button visible on mobile and desktop.
* Countdown Timer: Create urgency with product-specific or global timers.
* Exit Intent: Capture abandoning visitors with a special offer.

Brightery Conversion Toolkit for WooCommerce

Product Name: Brightery Conversion Toolkit for WooCommerce
Category: WooCommerce Conversion Optimization Plugin

Mission
Brightery Conversion Toolkit for WooCommerce is an all-in-one conversion optimization toolkit for WooCommerce stores. It replaces multiple single-purpose plugins with one lightweight, performance-first solution that increases trust, urgency, and checkout intent while keeping storefronts fast and clean.

Core Principles
– One plugin instead of many
– Lightweight frontend assets
– No theme conflicts
– Simple setup, powerful results
– Conversion psychology first
– Admin UX must be clean and professional
– Safe, secure, and Marketplace-compliant

Target Users
– WooCommerce store owners
– Shopify switchers coming to Woo
– Dropshippers and DTC brands
– Marketing agencies managing multiple stores
– Performance-focused merchants

Core Modules
1. Sales Pop (Social Proof). Shows “Someone purchased X minutes ago” toasts using real WooCommerce orders with privacy masking. Features include configurable interval, max toasts, position, and multiple visual templates (Classic, Dark, Glass, Gradient, Neon). Optional product image (future). Template selector and live preview in admin.
2. Sticky Add to Cart. Floating bar when the main ATC is off-screen. Mirrors product ATC action. Works on product pages. Lightweight and theme-safe.
3. Countdown (Urgency). Global countdown timer with per-product override. ISO date/time input (future: date picker). Used for promos, launches, and limited offers.
4. Exit Intent. Desktop triggers on mouse leaving top of viewport. Mobile triggers on back-button intent. Custom title, message, and button text. Optional rules: show once per session, delay, exclude checkout.

Targeting Rules Engine
– Enable on product pages only or all WooCommerce pages
– Devices: all, desktop only, mobile only

Templates System
– Templates defined in bundled JSON
– Admin selects template ID (no raw CSS input)
– Live preview in admin
– CSS injected safely from bundled assets

Admin Experience
– Single unified settings page
– Card-based layout
– Clear sections: Modules, Display & Templates, Sales Pop, Countdown, Exit Intent, Targeting Rules, License, Troubleshooting
– Safe saving (no settings wiping)
– All output escaped and sanitized
– Marketplace-ready UI

Technical Requirements
– Only load frontend assets on WooCommerce pages
– No fatal errors if WooCommerce is missing
– All admin actions protected by nonces and capability checks
– All output escaped, all input sanitized
– REST endpoints must not expose personal data
– Follow WooCommerce Marketplace coding standards
– Include changelog.txt with valid format
– Stable, predictable behavior in E2E tests

Success Metrics
– Increased add-to-cart rate
– Increased conversion rate
– Reduced plugin bloat for merchants
– Positive Marketplace reviews
– Low support ticket volume

Smart Suggestions
1. Campaign Presets system. Presets like “Flash Sale,” “Low Stock Urgency,” “Social Proof Booster,” and “Abandoned Visitor Recovery” that auto-configure enabled modules, default texts, intervals, and templates for faster onboarding.
2. Lightweight analytics (Phase 2). Track impressions per module, clicks on sticky ATC or exit intent, and orders after exposure. Display “Brightery Conversion Toolkit assisted X orders this week.”
3. Per-module targeting (Phase 2). Simple include/exclude lists by products or categories per module, and explicit exclusions for cart/checkout.
4. “Preview on Store” button. Admin button opens a product page with ?brightery_conversion_toolkit_preview=1 to force modules to show for testing.
5. Template marketplace later. Seasonal packs (Black Friday, Ramadan, Christmas), agency branding packs, and premium template bundles.
6. Positioning advice. Sell it as “Your conversion toolkit. One plugin instead of five.” Key messages: faster stores, fewer conflicts, cleaner admin, higher conversion rate.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/brightery-conversion-toolkit directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Brightery Conversion Toolkit to configure the modules.
sections.faq:
Does this work with any theme?

Yes, Brightery Conversion Toolkit for WooCommerce is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.
